title: Sign in
device: Sign in to connect your device.

passkey.help: Choose a passkey in the window your browser opened.

password.title: Enter your password
password.label: Password
password.wrong: That email and password don't match. Try again, or reset your password.

again.title: Confirm it's you
again.body: {{client}} asks you to sign in again before you continue.
again.bodyNoClient: Sign in again before you continue.

link.title: Get a sign-in link
link.body: We'll email you a link that signs you in once. It works for a short time.
link.sentBody: If {{email}} has an account here, a sign-in link is on its way. It works once, for a short time.
link.where: Open the link on the device and browser you want to be signed in on.
link.spam: Nothing after a minute? Look in your spam folder, or send it again.
link.resentBody: Use the link in the newest email.

magic.checkingBody: One moment while we check your link.
magic.failedTitle: This link can't sign you in
magic.failedBody: It may have been used already, or it's too old. We can send a new one to the same address.
magic.resentTitle: A new link is on its way
magic.resentBody: If the address has an account here, check your email. The new link works for a short time.
magic.missingBody: Part of the address is missing. Open the link from the email again, rather than copying it.
magic.networkTitle: You can't sign in from this network
magic.networkBody: Your organisation allows sign-in only from its own networks. Connect to one, then open the link again.

offer.title: Sign in faster next time
offer.body: Add a passkey, and sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of a password.
facts: It works only on Qeet ID's pages, so it can't be phished
Your password still works, and you can remove the passkey any time
offer.waitingHelp: Follow the window your browser opened.
offer.addedBody: Next time, choose Sign in with a passkey and use your fingerprint, face or screen lock.
offer.existsTitle: This device already has a passkey
offer.existsBody: It's ready for your next sign-in.
offer.cancelledBody: The window was closed before it finished. Try again, or skip it for now.

none.title: There's no way to sign in here
none.body: {{client}} has no sign-in method turned on yet. Tell your organisation's administrator; they can turn one on in the console.
none.bodyNoClient: This application has no sign-in method turned on yet. Tell your organisation's administrator; they can turn one on in the console.

locked.title: Sign-in is paused
locked.body: There were too many wrong passwords, so this account can't sign in for a while. Wait, or reset your password now.

inactive.title: This account is turned off
inactive.body: An administrator at your organisation turned it off. Ask them to turn it back on.

network.title: You can't sign in from this network
network.body: Your organisation allows sign-in only from its own networks. Connect to one (at the office, or on the VPN), then try again.

provider.title: That sign-in didn't work
provider.body: You may have cancelled, or the provider had a problem. Try again, or use another way.

unverified.title: Verify this address first
unverified.body: An account already uses this email address, but it hasn't been verified. Verify it, or reset its password from the link we email you, then sign in with this provider.

closed.title: This organisation only accepts invited members
closed.body: Ask an administrator for an invitation, or sign in with an account you already have.

passkey.title: Your passkey didn't sign you in
passkey.body: Try again, or use another way.

passkeyUnsupported.title: This browser can't use passkeys
passkeyUnsupported.body: Use another way to sign in, or a browser that supports passkeys.

mfa.title: Verify it's you
mfa.appBody: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.wrong: That code didn't work. Codes change every 30 seconds: enter the one your app shows now.
mfa.wrongSent: That code didn't work. Check the newest message, or send another code.
mfa.remember: Don't ask again on this device
mfa.waysBody: Use any of the ways you've set up.

recovery.title: Use a recovery code
recovery.detail: If you can't use the others

mfa.sentBody: We sent a 6-digit code to {{destination}}. It works for 10 minutes.
mfa.sendWait: A code was sent to {{destination}} recently. You can ask for another in {{time}}.
mfa.recoveryBody: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-step verification.

push.title: Approve on your phone
push.body: We sent a request to Qeet ID on your phone. Open it, check it's you, and type this number.
push.waiting: Waiting for your phone · ends in {{time}}
push.sending: Sending a request to your phone…
push.deniedBody: Nobody signed in. If it was you, send a new request. If it wasn't, someone may know your password: change it soon.
push.endedBody: Your phone didn't answer in time. Send a new request, or use another way.

enroll.title: Set up two-step verification
enroll.requiredBody: Your organisation asks for a second step when you sign in. Set up an authenticator app to continue; it takes a minute.
enroll.dueBody: Your organisation asks for a second step when you sign in, from {{date}}. Set it up now, or skip until then.
enroll.need: You need an authenticator app on your phone: Qeet ID, or any app that makes 6-digit codes.
enroll.scanTitle: Add Qeet ID to your app
enroll.scanBody: In your authenticator app, add an account, then scan this code.
enroll.phoneBody: Open your authenticator app from here, or add the key to it by hand.
enroll.qrLabel: QR code to add your Qeet ID account to an authenticator app
enroll.wrong: That code didn't match. Check the key was entered exactly, then enter the app's current code.

codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.body: If you lose your phone, each code signs you in once. Keep them somewhere safe: they won't be shown again.
codes.saved: I've saved these codes somewhere safe
